detail.title: 一种用于自动餐饮装置的夹爪
detail.abstract: A jaw for an automated catering assembly, comprising: clamping jaw, arm and clamping jaw mounting, wherein, the clamping jaw includes: the clamping jaw for the automatic catering device can flexibly control the clamping jaw to flexibly move through the mechanical arm, and the clamping jaw can stably and accurately clamp articles in the moving process; and the clamping jaw has simple structure, low manufacturing cost and convenient maintenance.
assignees: 比率机器人科技(北京)有限公司
